:::{#def-logarithm}
#### Logarithm

Let $b$ be a positive [real number](number-systems.qmd#def-real-numbers) with $b \ne 1$.
For every real number $x > 0$, the **logarithm** of $x$ to the base $b$ [@wikipedia_logarithm], written $\log_b x$,
is the real number $y$ with $b^y = x$ (@def-real-power).
Exactly one such $y$ exists, namely $y = \frac{\logf{x}}{\logf{b}}$.

:::
